purpose: Track intentionally mirrored example trees so they cannot drift silently. tools/validate_skills.py enforces this file.

mirrors.rule: Every relative file present in the canonical tree must exist byte-for-byte identical in the mirror. The mirror may add files under allowed_extra_in_mirror only.
mirrors.reason: Both examples ship the same atmosphere/geospatial/effects implementation; the LUT skill is canonical. Extraction would break either example's self-contained portability.
